messages.author: e3bc749b26ad7b97
messages.subject: compare results with different series expansions
parts:
Dear Forum,

I'm busy using Distance to obtain densities of a primate species in 4
forests. Once obtained the estimates I wanted to compare them statistically.
I have a very immediate question: can I compare results obtained with
different series expansions of the same key function?

this is an example of my function selection using AIC:

*DATASET*

*FOREST*

*KEY FUNCTION*

*SERIES EXPANSION*

*Species*

Magombera

Half-normal

Hermite polynomial

* *

Matundu

Half-normal

Cosine

* *

Mwanihana

Half-normal

Hermite polynomial

* *

Uzungwa Scarp Forest Reserve

Half-normal

Cosine

Can I compare the results?


Thank you very much for your help

Best regards
Alessandro Araldi

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: compare results with different series expansions
parts:
Alessandro:

Yes you can compare density estimates of data fitted with different
series expansion models. The nature of the data determine the detection
function appropriate for them. Have a look at Section 3.6.4 of Buckland
et al. (2001) on the subject of estimating change in density for the
case of comparing between pairs of estimates.
